body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi VOXEL-BLOCK toy figure of a hooded mystic with BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height like a scarecrow, elbows perfectly straight. The sleeves are SHORT and end well above the wrist, leaving the entire forearm, wrist and hand bare and clearly visible as a separate distinct block shape from the sleeve block -- a large gap of bare skin-block between the end of the sleeve and the hand, so the hand is obviously its own separate part, not blended into the fabric. Both blocky bare hands open with fingers spread, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge, flat hard-contrast shading. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky hooded robe (short sleeves only) with thick VIOLET-PURPLE trim block accents, a blocky pointed hood block shadowing the face with two flat glowing green rectangular eyes, a glowing violet gem block on the chest, a small book block on the belt. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
